question: What happens to the VP at 2 Influence and bonus at 4 if you later drop below them and return? How is an Alliance first gained or taken from a tied holder by advancing?
key: 2VP threshold gives1 and loses below2, regains on return;4 bonus kept when dropping and earn again crossing4; first to4 Alliance +its VP; tying holder not enough, must rise higher to take.

answer.answer: At 2 Influence you gain 1 VP, lost if you fall below 2 and regained if you reach 2 again. At 4 you gain the track bonus; you keep it if you later drop below 4 and can earn it again by dropping and advancing back. First to 4 takes the Alliance and its VP. Another player takes it only by advancing to a higher Influence than holder; tying alone does not take it.

question: Describe ordinary Intrigue privacy and destination, each type’s timing, what happens if the Intrigue deck runs out, and whether playing an Intrigue may avoid its printed cost or condition.
key: Keep face down separate from deck,may inspect,only reveal on play;Plot own Agent/Reveal,Combat Combat,Endgame gameend;resolve discard faceup beside Intrigue deck,shuffle Intrigue discards if exhausted;must meet conditions/pay cost to play.

answer.answer: Keep Intrigue cards face down and separate from deck; may look at them anytime, reveal only when playing; played cards discard face up by Intrigue deck, whose discard pile is reshuffled if deck runs out. Plot is during own Agent/Reveal turn, Combat only during Combat, Endgame only at end. A card’s costs/conditions must be met to play it; the summary does not detail any universal exception for avoiding them.

question: How do you prepare the humans’ initial decks, the Imperium Row, the Intrigue deck, the Reserve, the Mentat and Alliance tokens, and the initial first player before Round 1?
key: Each human shuffles their own standard ten-card starting deck and places it face down. Shuffle the Imperium deck and deal five face up to the Row; shuffle Intrigues face down separately. Place Arrakis Liaison, The Spice Must Flow, and Foldspace as three separate Reserve stacks beside the Row. Put the Mentat at its Landsraad space and the four Alliances on their marked Influence-track areas. Randomly choose the initial first player and give that player the marker.

answer.answer: Shuffle each human’s identical starting 10-card deck and place face down left of Leader. Shuffle Imperium deck face down and deal 5 face-up Row; shuffle Intrigue deck face down; set separate Reserve stacks for Arrakis Liaison, Spice Must Flow and Foldspace. Place Mentat on side on its space and Alliance tokens on tracks. Choose one First Player randomly and give them marker; in two-player also set up Hagal.
